charts.title: TOI-1806 b: orbits around TOI-1806
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1806's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1806 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.
